project_name: Enterprise Data Agent - Observability Control Center
summary: Engineering-grade AI observability control center inspired by Linear's dark canvas precision. Features deep obsidian/navy surfaces, hairline borders, restrained indigo/blue accents, semantic indicators, Geist sans-serif typography, and JetBrains Mono for SQL/code.

entry_surfaces./: Linear-precision observability command center — left compact sidebar, sticky topbar with system health status & range controls, 5 KPI metric cards, hero latency chart (Avg/P50/P95), 2-column split with endpoint health table and pipeline horizontal stages + performance hotspots
entry_surfaces./explorer: Pipeline Explorer — Interactive multi-stage AI workflow inspector with expandable stage execution graph, step-by-step latency breakdown, token distribution, and prompt/schema inspection panels
entry_surfaces./traces: Request Traces — Searchable and filterable AI query trace table with real-time status badges, waterfall flamegraph visualization, SQL query inspection modal with syntax highlighting, and retry event logs

grids_and_layouts.app_shell: flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#0B0D13] text-[#F8FAFC]
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: w-64 shrink-0 border-r border-[#161A24] bg-[#080A0F] flex flex-col justify-between p-4
grids_and_layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#161A24] bg-[#0B0D13]/90 backdrop-blur-md px-8 py-4
grids_and_layouts.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 px-8 pt-6 pb-2
grids_and_layouts.split_section: grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-6 px-8 py-4

MetricCard.description: Compact KPI card displaying metric title, formatted primary value, secondary benchmark text, trend delta indicator, and optional sparkline or subtle status badge.

LatencyChart.description: Hero responsive line chart using Recharts with Average, P50, and P95 latency series, custom styled dark tooltip, custom legend, and range switcher integration.

EndpointTable.description: Clean engineering table listing endpoints (/query, /docs, /openapi.json, /observability/overview) with Requests, Success, Failures, Average, P50, P95, Max columns. /query visually highlighted.

PipelineGroupChart.description: Horizontal bar visualization representing the AI pipeline stages (Understanding 1.76s, Retrieval 0.37s, Planning 3.71s, Validation 2.74s, Generation 1.01s). Features expandable nested sub-stages and visual emphasis on bottleneck stages.

PerformanceHotspots.description: Targeted hotspot cards ranking the slowest stages (Business Intent 5.72s, Reasoning 4.75s, SQL Review 3.80s, Intent Classification 2.70s) using engineering descriptors like 'Slowest' and 'High Latency' (avoiding misleading 'Critical' labels).

TraceViewerModal.description: Detailed trace inspection drawer/dialog showing request timeline, prompt input, generated SQL query in JetBrains Mono, execution logs, and pipeline latency waterfall.

TelemetryProvider.description: Mock telemetry state provider supporting 1h/6h/24h/7d time ranges, auto-refresh toggle, manual refresh trigger, and simulated telemetry data models readily swappable with GET /observability/overview.

motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Apply subtle scale(0.98) on active button click, opacity/translate-y micro transitions for expanding accordion stages, and smooth 250ms transition on metric value shifts.

accessibility.wcag_target: APCA & WCAG AA (Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all standard copy)

instructions_to_main_agent.font_setup: Import '@fontsource-variable/geist' and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono' in frontend/src/index.css. Set --font-sans to Geist Variable and --font-mono to JetBrains Mono Variable.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Ensure frontend/index.html uses <html class='dark'> and index.css defines dark tokens with page background #0B0D13, card surface #11141E, and border #1E2330.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_semantics_rule: Strict rule: Never confuse 0 with No Data. When value is 0, display '0' (e.g., '0.00%', '0 failures'). Display 'No data' only when metric is null or unrecorded.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_standard: Linear-quality dark UI polish for AI observability platform.
anti_patterns: NO generic light themes or bright neon cyberpunk glows
NO terminal/hacker green text over black
NO unstyled raw HTML tables — use refined cell spacing and muted badges
NO default Inter font for headers; use Geist Variable with tight tracking
NO generic cards for every element; use structured grids, dividers, and surface elevation
layout_polish: Use 1px hairline borders with rgba(255,255,255,0.08) or #1E2433
Add subtle pill badges with dot indicators for status
Make /query row in Endpoint Table highlighted with a subtle blue/indigo left border or tint
Use JetBrains Mono for SQL queries, latencies (e.g., 36.24s, 0.486s), and endpoint paths
